method: Every original record was inventoried and its nomenclature, functional/clinical prose, connections, broad arterial supply and location/shape description reviewed against the supplied textbooks. Selected conflicting or emerging claims were checked against primary human/animal research and an official ILAE consensus. Text extraction was paired with visual inspection of Haines p15/PDF29 Fig2-7 and Blumenfeld p833/PDF859 Fig18.10. This audit does not establish independent quantitative mesh validation.
geometry_scope: Coordinates use the project custom frame (x positive toward patient left, y superior, z anterior) and custom teaching units. Original numbers, dimensions, waypoints, levels and surface anchors were retained. The level arithmetic is a marker-metadata consistency flag, not an actual intersection or empirical registration result.
